scripts.server:build: ncc build ./src/server.ts -o ./dist --source-map --external bun:sqlite --external bun && bun run sentry:sourcemaps:if-token
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: sentry-cli sourcemaps inject --org metorial --project mte-subspace-worker ./dist && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org metorial --project mte-subspace-worker ./dist
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps:if-token: sh -c 'if [ -n "$SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN" ]; then bun run sentry:sourcemaps; else echo "Skipping Sentry sourcemap upload"; fi'
